item.title: Africa's Deadliest Man-Eater Is Still Hunting #shorts
item.description:
300 victims. 0 captures. One Nile crocodile that's been terrorizing Africa for decades — and he's never been caught. 🐊
This is the true story of Gustave: a 20-foot, 1-ton Nile crocodile that scientists have been tracking for over 20 years. He's the most documented man-eater in history and the subject of our latest documentary.
🎥 Watch the full Gustave documentary on this channel — link in bio. https://youtu.be/WJUewuqlt7s
🔔 Subscribe for more nightmare fuel from the deep.
